entry.title: Sol Next v9.3.0-public (Build 930) — Full-Stack Rust 2024 (Zero Python), SOTA 24kHz On-Device Voice (X-ASR 160ms + Kokoro v1.1), ARM64 NEON/SVE2 + Vulkan + NPU Kernel, Android 13 Non-Stealing IME & Mature Cloud Auth with Free DeepSeek
entry.summary: Flagship v9.3.0 release delivering 100% zero-Python Full-Stack Rust 2024 architecture (rust/sol-builder, sol-world-rs 16.7 MB RSS, sol-engine-rs 3.66 MB RSS), 2026 SOTA 24kHz on-device neural voice (X-ASR 160ms RTF 0.20 + Kokoro v1.1 24kHz HD 103 voices RTF 0.701), hand-written ARM64 NEON/DotProd/I8MM/SVE2 inline assembly + Vulkan 1.1 Compute Shaders + NNAPI NPU kernel (libsol_kernel.so v600, up to 6.04x speedup), Android 13 zero-MotionEvent IME isolation, mature PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 cloud account center unlocking free built-in DeepSeek, and 371/371 passing tests.

entry.title: Sol Next v9.2.0-public (Build 920) — 12-Upgrade Apex Execution Kernel, Zero-Anim Toggle, Headset/Car-BT Task Voice Gating, Zero-Lag TextFieldState IME & 3-Tab AI Phone Call Suite
entry.summary: Major v9.2.0 upgrade featuring 12 execution-engine improvements, dedicated System Zero-Animation toggle, 3-mode Task Voice Broadcast Control (Off / Headset & Car BT / Always), Compose TextFieldState zero-lag IME with IME-aware PiP auto-tucking, complete 3-tab AI Phone Call Suite, and real Photo/Document/Agent/Memory end-to-end integration.

entry.title: Sol Next v9.1.2-public (Build 912) — Material 3 Dual-Mode, Mandatory 2-Stage Onboarding, Built-In Brave Search & On-Device 4-Stage Realtime Voice
entry.summary: Full native Material 3 Light/Dark dual-mode UI (Chat | Task), mandatory 2-stage login and system permission setup gate, built-in DeepSeek Flash & Brave Search, bundled 4-stage on-device neural voice, and hands-free Notification Voice Readout.
